description: This file defines the main activity class DumpActivity for the DumpViewer Android app. It manages UI components, handles user interactions, executes commands (like 'dumpsys' and 'logcat') on the device via ADB, and displays the output in a WebView. It also provides features such as command history, search, regex insertion, and pickers for package and process names.

classes.name: DumpActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling the dump viewer UI, command execution, and interaction logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, loads preferences, sets up autocomplete, and binds event handlers.

methods.name: refreshUi
methods.description: Updates the UI elements' enabled state based on current input.

methods.name: refreshHistory
methods.description: Loads command, regex, and search histories into autocomplete adapters.

methods.name: buildCommandLine
methods.description: Constructs the shell command to execute based on user inputs and options.

methods.name: doStartCommand
methods.description: Triggers execution of the command specified in the command line.

methods.name: startCommand
methods.description: Starts AsyncTask to run the command and handle output.

methods.name: Dumper
methods.description: AsyncTask subclass that runs the command, captures output, and updates the UI.

methods.name: onContentLoaded
methods.description: Scrolls the WebView to bottom/top after content load if needed.

methods.name: onFindNextClicked
methods.description: Finds the next occurrence of the search query in the WebView.

methods.name: onFindPrevClicked
methods.description: Finds the previous occurrence of the search query in the WebView.

methods.name: toggleHeader
methods.description: Shows or hides the header view.

methods.name: onRePickerClicked
methods.description: Displays the regex meta-character picker dialog.

methods.name: onMultiPickerClicked
methods.description: Displays the package/process name picker dialog.
